newsitem.title: USA: Brooks to resell local service to ARC.
newsitem.headline: Brooks to resell local service to ARC.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said it has signed a three-year agreement to provide ARC Networks Inc with local resale telecommunication services in various markets.
In a release dated November 18, Brooks said the deal will initially include Hartford, Conn., Springfield, Mass., Providence, R.I., and Grand Rapids, Mich.
The resale agreement allows ARC to begin marketing Brooks Fiber's local telecommunications services under the ARC name without having to build networks in those markets.
